name: The Hermitage, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel, Jakarta
short_description: A 90-room five-star boutique hotel in a restored 1920s Art Deco building in leafy Menteng -- Indonesia's first Tribute Portfolio property, with colonial-era heritage, modern comforts, a rooftop pool and the La Vue bar.
ai_summary: The Hermitage occupies a restored 1920s Art Deco landmark, originally a Dutch-era telephone/PTT office, in the tree-lined embassy district of Menteng. Launched in 2015 as Indonesia's first Tribute Portfolio hotel, it pairs colonial character with 90 spacious rooms and suites (from around 40 sqm), a ninth-floor rooftop pool and the La Vue rooftop bar. On TripAdvisor it holds roughly a 4.0 of 5 rating, ranked among Jakarta's mid-upper tier. Independent reviewers consistently praise the heritage architecture, generous room sizes, quiet yet central location and an impressive breakfast at Restaurant 1928 mixing Western and Indonesian dishes. Elite Marriott Bonvoy members report warm recognition, upgrades and responsive e-butler service via WhatsApp. Criticism is not uncommon: one detailed reviewer described chaotic breakfast service, inconsistent housekeeping and rooms that felt overpriced at rack rate, while others note the rooftop pool lacks a real skyline view and Jakarta traffic makes the airport run long. Overall the property reads as a characterful, service-led heritage stay that rewards points redemptions more than full cash rates.

Spacious, well-appointed rooms and suites in quiet, upscale Menteng
Well-regarded breakfast at Restaurant 1928 with Western and Indonesian options
Rooftop pool and La Vue bar plus warm elite-member recognition
cons: Service and breakfast consistency can be uneven (some chaotic-service reports)

Feels overpriced at standard cash rates; long airport transfers in Jakarta traffic

faqs.question: What makes The Hermitage Jakarta historically significant?
faqs.answer: It occupies a 1920s Art Deco building (built by the Dutch, originally a telephone/PTT office) in the historic Menteng district, and was Indonesia's first Tribute Portfolio hotel when it launched in 2015.

faqs.question: Where is the hotel and how far is the airport?
faqs.answer: It sits on Jl. Cilacap in Menteng, Central Jakarta, near embassies and the Jalan Surabaya antique market. Soekarno-Hatta International (CGK) is roughly 25 km away, but transfers can take an hour or more in heavy traffic.

faqs.question: Does the hotel have a pool and rooftop bar?
faqs.answer: Yes. There is a rooftop pool on the ninth floor and the La Vue rooftop bar, plus a fitness center and spa. Reviewers enjoy the setting, though several note the pool lacks a wide skyline view.

reviews.title: Review: The Hermitage, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel, Jakarta
reviews.author: Koen
reviews.summary: Enthusiastic review of the Menteng heritage hotel: spacious room, impressive Western/Indonesian breakfast buffet, delicious nasi goreng and exceptional service. Minor gripes: weak coffee and heavy airport traffic.

reviews.title: Review: The Hermitage, A Tribute Portfolio, Jakarta (1-Bedroom And Studio Suites)
reviews.author: Fai
reviews.summary: Mixed points-stay in studio and 1-bedroom suites. Good value on redemption and elite recognition, but flags chaotic breakfast service, loud housekeeping, poor pool/room views and AC issues. Overpriced at the ~$190 cash rate.

reviews.title: Review: The Hermitage Jakarta | Marriott Bonvoy
reviews.author: Etienne Werbinski
reviews.summary: Titanium Elite reviewer scores it 8/10: upgraded to an executive suite, efficient check-in, a WhatsApp e-butler, quiet rooms and an impressive breakfast at Restaurant 1928. Small aesthetic flaws and limited gym hours the only cons.
